# American Kennel Club

> > The American Kennel Club (AKC) is the official registry and authority for purebred dog breeds in the United States, providing breed standards, rescue networks, training resources, and health guidance.

AKC.org serves as the comprehensive resource for dog owners, breeders, and enthusiasts, offering detailed profiles for over 200 recognized breeds organized by AKC groups (Sporting, Working, Terrier, etc.), along with expert advice on training, health, and lifestyle. The site also coordinates the AKC Rescue Network connecting breed-specific rescue organizations with adopters.

## Key Topics

- AKC breed standards and recognition
- AKC Rescue Network
- Dog breed profiles and information
- Sporting dogs and hunting breeds
- Terrier breeds
- AKC Humane Fund
- Breed-specific rescue organizations
- Dog training and behavior
- Canine health and nutrition
- AKC.tv
- Purebred dog registry
- AKC Library & Archives
- Dog show standards
- Breed groups and classifications

## Dog Breed Information

- [AKC Breeds Broken Out By Group](https://www.akc.org/akc-breeds-by-group): Complete AKC breed directory organized by classification groups
- [French Bulldog Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/french-bulldog): French Bulldog breed profile with personality, history & AKC standards
- [German Wirehaired Pointer Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/german-wirehaired-pointer): German Wirehaired Pointer breed profile with personality, history & standards
- [Weimaraner Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/weimaraner): Weimaraner sporting dog breed profile with AKC standards & history
- [Kerry Blue Terrier Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/kerry-blue-terrier): Kerry Blue Terrier breed profile with personality, history & AKC standards
- [Airedale Terrier Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/airedale-terrier): Airedale Terrier breed profile with personality, history & AKC standards
- [American Water Spaniel Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/american-water-spaniel): American Water Spaniel breed profile with personality, history & standards
- [Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/nova-scotia-duck-tolling-retriever): Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever breed profile with AKC standards
- [Lagotto Romagnolo Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/lagotto-romagnolo): Lagotto Romagnolo breed profile with personality, history & AKC standards
- [Yakutian Laika - Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/yakutian-laika): Yakutian Laika breed profile with personality, history & AKC standards
- [Pudelpointer - Dog Breed Information](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/pudelpointer): Pudelpointer hunting dog breed profile with AKC standards & history

## AKC Rescue Network

- [Rescue Network L Breeds](https://www.akc.org/akc-rescue-network/rescue-network-l-breeds): AKC Rescue Network directory for dog breeds starting with letter L

- [Rescue Network X Breeds](https://www.akc.org/akc-rescue-network/rescue-network-x-breeds): AKC Rescue Network directory for dog breeds starting with letter X

## Dog Training and Behavior

- [How to Break Up a Dogfight: Stop Dogs From Fighting](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/training/dogfights-the-dos-and-donts): Safety guide for breaking up dogfights and managing canine aggression

## Dog Health and Nutrition

- [5 Common Dog Illnesses That Are Impacted by Nutrition](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/health/5-common-dog-illnesses): How nutrition affects common dog illnesses and dietary options

## Dog Lifestyle and Owner Resources

- [10 Things Only A Havanese Owner Would Understand](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/lifestyle/10-things-havanese): Breed-specific insights and humor for Havanese dog owners
- [10 Fun Facts About AKC's Newest Italian Breeds](https://www.akc.org/expert-advice/lifestyle/columbus-day-cuties-italian-breeds): Fun facts about Italian dog breeds including Bergamasco, Puli & Komondor
